content: Coat-wagan-arbamaloed
Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga, degi, Aarónʼga sunmakded, ega sogded:
“Leví-wagan-abargi, Coat-wagan na e-dadgan-e-dadganba, na e-gwenad-e-gwenadganba, be ebiso.
Bela machergan birga-durgwen-gakambe-nikamalad (30), degi, birga-durbo-gakambe-nikamaladse (50), dulemar-anbo-ambikued-neggi sunna-arbamaloed, be ebiso.
”Coat-wagan dulemar-anbo-ambikued-neggi, ibmarmar-ise-islidikid akwega be imakoed:

Bemar danar-danar-bukwamaladgi baid-negse-naesokarmalale, Aarón, degi, e-masmala nonimaloed, anse-goled-negse dogmaloed, mor-dummagan Nega-Ise-Islidikid-idu-nanaid weemaloed. A-morgi, Dulemar-Anbo-Igar-Mesisad-Ulu anwoed.
A-birgine, ibdurgan-uka-nuegan oginmaloed. Geb agi, Aarón, degi, e-masmala, a-uka-birgi mor-aradbiid oginmarbaloed. Geb degine, Ulu-sedmalaga egi e-suarmar yomaloed.
”Madu-anga-ukleged-mese-birgi mor-arad oginmaloed. Geb agi, batemar, wesarmar, nogmar, degi, bormo-dukwa-ibmar-eogega-ebuleged urbemaloed. Madude a-mesegi bukwagu guoed.
A-ibmarmar-birgine, mor-ginnid oginmaloed. Geb birgine, ibdurgan-uka-nuegan oginmarbaloed. Geb a-sorbali, mese-sedmalaga egi e-suarmar yomaloed.

”Geb degine, Aarón, degi, e-masmala mor-arad sumaloed. A-mor-aradgi gwallumar-sied anwemaloed, degi, e-gwallumar, gwallu-gwillodub-sikmalad-e-disla, e-bate-burwigana, degine, bela olivo-gwallu-simalad-e-nogmar agi anwemarbaloed.
Geb degine, gwallumar-sied, degi, bela egi-ibmar-ebulemaladi, ibdurgan-uka-nuegangi anwemaloed. Geb degi, nabir-sedmalaga suar-wargwengi be nasikoed.
”Ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila-olobiidi mor-aradgi anwemaloed, geb, ibdurgan-uka-nuegan e-birgi anwebaloed. Geb degine, nabir-sedmalaga e-suarmar egi yomarbaloed.

”Aarón, degi, e-masmala, bela ibmar-anse-goled-neggi-ebulemalad weemaloed. Geb mor-aradgi anwemaloed, degi, ibdurgan-uka-nuegangi anwemarbaloed. Geb degine, nabir-sedmalaga suar-wargwengi be nasikoed.
”Ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailagi buru-bukwad weemaloed. Geb a-aila mor-suir-akwagiidgi anwemarbaloed.
A-aila-birgi, bela e-ibmar-ebulemalad urbemarbaloed:

content.text: A-ibmarmar-birgine, ibdurgan-uka-nuegan oginmaloed, degine, nabir-sedmalaga suarmargi nasikmaloed.

content: ”Aarón, degi, e-masmala, bela anse-goled-neggi, degi, anse-goled-neggi-ibmar-ebulemalad-bukwad bela morgi anwisale, geb agi Israel-dulemar naega guakwagusale, Coat-wagan nonimaloed, a-ibmarmar sedmalagar. Degi-inigwele, ibmar-angadga-gusadi na e-argangi ebugosurmalad. Ar ebusmalale, burgwemaloed. Bela we-ibmarmar dulemarbo-an-ambikued-neggi-bukwadi, Coat-wagan sedmaloed.

”Eleazarʼdi, dule-irwa-anse-goled Aarónʼye-nugad-e-machid. We-Eleazarʼde gwalluga gwalludii-baloedid, degi, ina-wawadikmalad, ibmar-gwag-gusgu-ukleged, degine, olivo-gwallu-ibmarmargi-eolegega-ebuleged dakoedid. Deginbali, Eleazar bela anse-goled-neg, degine, agi bela-ibmarmar-bukwad dakbaloed. Deginbali, bela agi-ibmarmar-ebulesimalad dakbaloed.”
Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga, degi, Aarónʼga sunmakdebalid, ega sogdebalid:
“Leví-wagan-abargi, melle Coat-wagan-obelogega be imako.

Coat-wagan ibmar-anga-nugsalesmaladse nonisogele, dula-gudigumalagala, melle burgwemalaga, weyob be imako. ”Aarón, degi, e-masmala Coat-waganga sogoed, ibu-ibmar imakmaloe, degi, ega sogbaloed, ibu-ibmarmar sedmarbaloe.
”Aarón, degi, e-masmala ibmar-anga-nugsalesmalad anwelenaile, Coat-wagan dogosurmalad, degine, bipisaale dakosurmarbalid. Ar dogmalale, burgwemaloed.”
Gersón-wagan-e-arbaed
Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sunmakdebalid, ega sogdebalid:
“Gersón-wagan, e-dadgan-e-dadganba, na e-gwenad-e-gwenadganba be ebiso.
Bela machergan birga-dulagwen-gakambe-nikamalad (30), degi, birga-dulabo-gakambe-nikamaladse (50), dulemar-anbo-ambikued-neggi sunna-arbamaloed be ebiso.

”Gersón-wagan bela na e-arbamaladgi, na ibmar semamaidgindibe, anse-goled-neggi arbananaidgindibe, bela Aarón, degi, e-masmala-sogedba ibmar imakmaloed. Gersón-waganga be sogoed, we-ibmarmar sedsokarmalale, nue salakarmaloye.
Gersón-wagan dulemar-anbo-ambikued-neggi weyob ibmar imakmaloed.
Merari-wagan-e-arbaed
Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sogdebalid: “Merari-wagan, e-dadgan-e-dadganba, na e-gwenad-e-gwenadganba, be ebiso.
Bela machergan birga-dulagwen-gakambe-nikamalad (30), degi, birga-dulabo-gakambe-nikamaladse (50), sunna dulemar-anbo-ambikued-neggi arbamaloed be ebisoed.
We-dulemar dulemar-anbo-ambikued-neggi urgomar-ebulesad sedmaloed.
”Dule-war-wargwenga be sogoed, ibu-ibmarmar sedmaloe.
We-arbaedi Merari-wagan, na e-dadgan-e-dadganba, degisadegu na e-arbaedgi dulemar-anbo-ambikued-neggi arbamaloed.
Coat-wagan na e-dadgan-e-dadganba-ebislesad
Moisés, Aarón, degi, Israel-dulemar-danar-danar-bukwamalad-e-dummaganmala, Coat-wagan, na e-dadgan-e-dadganba, na e-gwenad-e-gwenadganba ebichismarsunnad.
Bela machergan birga-durgwen-gakambe-nikamalad (30), degi, birga-durbo-gakambe-nikamaladse (50) bela sunna Bab-Dummad-dulemarbo-ambikued-neggi-arbamaloed ebichilesad.
Weyob Coat-wagan na e-dadgan-e-dadganba ebislesmargu, milibo gaka dulataled-ilagugle gaka dulabo-gakambe (2,750) mergu daklealid.

Weyob bela Coat-wagan e-dadgan-e-dadganba ebislesmalad. A-dulemarde bela sunna Bab-Dummad-dulemarbo-ambikued-neggi arbamaloed. Weyob Moisés, degi, Aarón, Coat-wagan ebichismalad. Bab-Jehová-Moisésʼga-igar-uksadba imaksamalad.
Gersón-wagan e-dadgan-e-dadganba-ebislesad
Moisés, Aarón, degi, Israel-dulemar-danar-danar-bukmalad-e-dummaganmala, Gersón-wagan e-dadgan-e-dadganba, na e-gwenad-e-gwenadganba ebichismarmogad.
Bela machergan birga-durgwen-gakambe-nikamalad (30), degi, birga-dulabo-gakambe-nikamaladse (50), sunna Bab-Dummad-dulemarbo-ambikued-neggi arbanonimaloed ebichilesad.
Weyob Gersón-wagan e-dadgan-e-dadganba, degine, na e-gwenad-e-gwenadganba ebislesmargu, milibo gaka dulataled-ilanergwa gaka dulagwen-gakambe (2,630) mergu daklealid.

Weyob bela Gersón-wagan, e-dadgan-e-dadganba, ebislesmalad. A-dulemarde bela sunna Bab-Dummad-dulemarbo-ambikued-neggi arbamaloed. Weyob Moisés, degi, Aarón, Gersón-wagan-ebichismalad. Bab-Jehová-Moisésʼga-igar-uksadba imaksamalad.
Merari-wagan e-dadgan-e-dadganba-ebislesad
Moisés, Aarón, degi, Israel-dulemar-danar-danar-bukwamalad-e-dummaganmala, Merari-wagan, na e-dadgan-e-dadganba, na e-gwenad-e-gwenadganba ebichismarmogad.
Bela machergan birga-durgwen-gakambe-nikamalad (30), degi, birga-dulabo-gakambe-nikamaladse (50) sunna Bab-Dummad-dulemarbo-ambikued-neggi arbanonimaloed ebichilesad.
Weyob Merari-wagan na e-dadgan-e-dadganba ebislesmargu, milipaa gaka dulataled-ilabo (3,200) mergu daklealid.
Weyobi Moisés, degi, Aarón, bela Merari-wagan, na e-dadgan-e-dadganba-mergue ebichismalad. Amar Bab-Jehová-Moisésʼga-igar-uksadba imaksamalad.
Leví-wagan e-dadgan-e-dadganba-ebislesad
Moisés, Aarón, degi, Israel-girmar-dummagan bela Leví-wagan na e-dadgan-e-dadganba, na e-gwenad-e-gwenadganba ebichismaladi,
machergan birga-durgwen-gakambe-nikamalad (30), degi, birga-durbo-gakambe-nikamaladse (50) sunna Bab-Dummad-dulemarbo-ambikued-neggi arbanonimaloedi, degine, sunna we-negsemaloedi,
bela we-dulemar milibaabak gaka dulataled-ilatar gaka dulabake (8,580) mergu daklealid.
Moisés, Bab-Jehová-igi-ega-igar-uksadba, dulemarga ibmar-imaked-igar uksad, degine, ibmar-sedmaloed-igar uksabalid. Moisés, Bab-Jehová-ega-igar-uklesadba, weyob dulemar-ebichisad.
